name: cerezium-autopilot
description: Cerezium Autopilot: extensión de Chrome que automatiza Google Flow para producir Shorts en lote (MUNDO FUT / The Odd Ledger).

scripts.check: for f in extension/*.js tests/*.js tools/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8')); console.log('manifest OK')" && node tests/check-ids.js
